title: Overview
snapshotHint: Current connections and reporting; journeys follow the selected period.

kpis.label: Whole-fleet totals
kpis.liveHint: Online means a device is connected and reporting on time. GPS position age is shown separately.
kpis.connectedHint: A current device connection, including unassigned devices. Open to see every connected device.
kpis.problemHint: Current open alerts and reporting gaps, plus device operations needing follow-up in this period. Recorded fault evidence is separate.

map.title: Fleet locations
map.coverage: {positioned} of {total} vehicles have a position · {missing} without a position
map.partial: Map coverage is incomplete while the remaining vehicles load.
map.partialError: The map is incomplete. Some vehicles could not be loaded.
map.error: Fleet locations could not be loaded

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.hint: Start with the most severe problems; within each severity, the latest appear first.
attention.empty: Nothing needs attention in this period.

connection.title: Online and connection status
connection.hint: Select a slice to see those vehicles on the map.
connection.summary: {live} online · {connected} connected · {total} vehicles. Online requires a connected device with an on-time report; GPS age is separate.

distance.title: Recorded distance per day
distance.summary: Only supplied days inside the selected period are shown, through the vehicle data clock. Zero means no recorded trip distance for that day.
distance.empty: No daily distance is available for this period.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.documents: {count} drivers have expired documents or documents due today
drivers.empty: No expired documents or documents due today.

devices.title: Connected devices
devices.hint: Every current device connection in the fleet, including devices without a vehicle.
devices.partial: The list is incomplete while the remaining devices are checked.
devices.partialError: Some devices could not be checked; this list is incomplete.
devices.empty: No connected devices in this snapshot.
